_meta.important_caveat: This fixture is a SYNTHETIC document written to mirror the real structure/content areas of the Home Affairs subclass 189 page (age, work experience, skills assessment, occupation, English, points, health, character, invitation, nomination, validity, fee, family, legislative basis, documents). It is NOT scraped verbatim government text - this sandbox has no live network access to the real page (see validation/phase1_audit_2026-08-20.md). It exists solely to let the Phase 2 pipeline (chunk selection, extraction, schema validation, evidence validation, normalization, dedup, persistence, review, gold-set evaluation) be built and measured end-to-end. Real production gold-set curation MUST be redone from the live-fetched government page before any of these numbers are treated as representing real-world extraction quality.

items.requirement: Age must be under 45 at time of invitation
items.evidence_text: Applicants must be under 45 years of age at the time of invitation.

items.requirement: At least 3 years relevant full-time work experience
items.evidence_text: Applicants must have at least three (3) years of relevant full-time work experience in a nominated skilled occupation.

items.requirement: Suitable skills assessment required for nominated occupation
items.evidence_text: Applicants must have a suitable skills assessment for a nominated skilled occupation on the relevant skilled occupation list.

items.requirement: Skills assessment must be current/valid at time of invitation, with an exception
items.evidence_text: The skills assessment must be current and valid at the time of invitation, unless the assessing authority states otherwise.
items.expected_exception: unless the assessing authority states otherwise

items.requirement: Nominated occupation must be on the Medium and Long-term Strategic Skills List
items.evidence_text: The nominated occupation must be on the Medium and Long-term Strategic Skills List at the time of invitation.

items.requirement: Competent English or approved equivalent test required
items.evidence_text: Applicants must have competent English or an approved equivalent test result.

items.requirement: English requirement exemption for specified passport holders
items.evidence_text: Applicants may be exempt from the English language requirement if they hold a passport from the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, New Zealand or Ireland.

items.requirement: Minimum 65 points on the points test
items.evidence_text: You must score at least 65 points on the points test to be eligible to submit an expression of interest.

items.requirement: Points table (age band 25-32 = 30 points)
Points table (age band 33-39 = 25 points)
Points table (proficient English = 10 points)
items.evidence_text: Proficient English | 10

items.requirement: Applicant and included family members must meet health requirement
items.evidence_text: Applicants and their family members included in the application must meet the health requirement.

items.requirement: Character requirement incl. penal clearance certificates
items.evidence_text: Applicants must satisfy the character requirement, including providing a penal clearance certificate for each country lived in for 12 months or more in the last 10 years.

items.requirement: Cannot apply without an invitation
items.evidence_text: Applicants cannot apply for this visa unless they have been invited to apply by the Department.

items.requirement: Invitation valid for 60 days from issue
items.evidence_text: An invitation is valid for 60 days from the date it is issued.

items.requirement: No state/territory nomination required for 189 (contrast with 190)
items.evidence_text: This subclass does not require state or territory nomination, unlike the Skilled Nominated visa (subclass 190).

items.requirement: Permanent visa, 5-year travel validity
items.evidence_text: This is a permanent visa. Once granted, holders can travel to and from Australia for five years from the date of grant.

items.requirement: Application fee applies, additional per family member (no fixed AUD figure given)
items.evidence_text: The base application charge for the main applicant is subject to the fee schedule published by the Department, and additional charges apply for each family member included in the application.

items.requirement: Partner/dependent children may be included, subject to health/character
items.evidence_text: Applicants may include a partner and dependent children in the application, subject to the family member meeting public interest criteria including health and character requirements.

items.requirement: Legal basis - Schedule 2, Subclass 189 of the Migration Regulations 1994
items.evidence_text: The criteria for this subclass are set out in Schedule 2, Subclass 189 of the Migration Regulations 1994, and applicants must satisfy the criteria applicable at the time of invitation and the time of decision, subject to any transitional arrangements prescribed in the Regulations.

expected_reference.target_text: Schedule 2, Subclass 189 of the Migration Regulations 1994
